title: Brick stables behind 2109 and 2123 Prairie
items: The stable behind 2109 Prairie now stands on the alley as a long two-storey brick building between two fire walls, with two carriage doors and a loft hatch, the window the 1911 fire-insurance map marks there, and a paved yard and a walk back to the house.

The stable behind 2123 Prairie stands against a fire wall to the north and opens a gable end to its own yard on the south, with a window on the alley and another in the gable where the map marks them.
